svg.text: In a channel, each run from another sender is named

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: above its first bubble and carries the sender’s avatar

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: beside its last; tapping the avatar opens the member

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: sheet (conversation info board). A member the phone

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: cannot name reads “Member” and the node hint, as on

svg.text: iOS.

svg.text: A gap where messages are missing is an empty bubble

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: with a down arrow: tapping requests them, a spinner

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: shows while they are asked for, and “Message

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: unavailable” replaces it if they never come. My

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: messages in an open channel are green.
